enchantments.tooltip: Competence Elemental Resistance - 15: This item provides a +15 Competence bonus to your Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical resistances.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.

Proof Against Poison +12: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +12 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 13 + their Fortitude save).
Wizardry +302: +302 Enhancement bonus to spell points.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
